content.short: Fluvi Wallet is a full-featured AA smart wallet built on Account Abstraction, designed to be a Web3 gateway.
content.description: Fluvi Wallet is a full-featured smart wallet built on Account Abstraction, designed to be a Web3 gateway for everyone by solving the security and usability flaws of traditional EOA wallets. It offers on-chain 2FA, mitigates the single point of failure from private keys, enables multi-device synchronization without a private key, seedless recovery, gasless transactions, and easy batch processing of transactions. Together these features dramatically improve security, convenience, and scalability compared with existing wallet services.
